# MO Transfers4all Athens

> A licensed taxi driver serving Athens and Attica, Greece. Airport pickups, long-distance trips, sightseeing day tours, and port/ferry connections — fixed prices agreed before the ride, no meter, no surprises.

MO Transfers4all is operated by Marjus Oruci, a licensed professional taxi driver based in Athens. Bookings are made directly through the website; fares are fixed and confirmed at time of booking, inclusive of tolls.

## Site

- [Home (English)](https://mo-transfers4all.gr/): booking form, fleet, rates, and popular destinations.
- [Home (Greek)](https://mo-transfers4all.gr/gr): the same site in Greek.
- [Athens Airport transfer](https://mo-transfers4all.gr/destinations/airport): fixed-price airport pickups with flight monitoring.
- [Privacy Policy](https://mo-transfers4all.gr/privacy): GDPR data handling, including the 30-day automatic erasure of personal booking data.
- [Terms of Service](https://mo-transfers4all.gr/terms): booking, cancellation, and fare terms.
